Restricted.grantPermission: grants a bytes32 permission to an agent.
Restricted.revokePermission: revokes a permission from an agent.
MultiSig.sign: signer signs a script, may move it to Approved on quorum.
MultiSig.execute: delegatecalls an approved script address.
MultiSig.cancelScript: only callable via the multisig itself.
MultiSig.addSigners: adds new signers (only via multisig).

Exchange.placeSellTokenOrder: pulls tokens via transferFrom then creates order.
Exchange._fillOrder: computes fill rate and swaps token/ETH.
LoanManager.newEthBackedLoan: payable loan creation using rates.

Locker.releaseFunds: unlocks matured lock plus interest.
delegatecall in MultiSig.execute to an arbitrary approved script address.

normalization_plan.reason: The script address parameter is only meaningful as the delegatecall target of MultiSig.execute.
The agent parameter is normalised into the permission granting operation it feeds.
The permission key parameter is only used inside the grant/revoke permission functions.
The recipient parameter is a transient argument of the token transfer functions.
The amount parameter is a transient argument of the token transfer functions.
The owner parameter is folded into the agreement creation call.
The agreement hash parameter is folded into the agreement creation call.
The discount parameter is only stored inside the new agreement.
The valuationCap parameter is only stored inside the new agreement.
The symbol parameter is normalised into the rate feeding operation.
The rate value parameter is normalised into the rate feeding operation.
The wei input is only consumed by the exchange fee stub.
The value parameter is only consumed by the rate conversion functions.
The signature bytes are normalised into the delegated transfer verification flow.
The nonce is only used to build the signed transfer hash.
The signed fee maximum is only checked inside the fee verification helper.
The requested fee is only compared and paid inside the fee verification helper.
The recovered address is a transient local of the signature verification helper.
The receiver target is normalised into the notify transfer external call.
The notification data is only forwarded to the receiver callback.
The locked amount is normalised into the interest request KPI update.
The interest amount is only used by the interest request operation.
The loan amount is normalised into the loan issuance operation.
The borrower address is only used by the loan issuance operation.
The loan id is normalised into the loan repayment operation.
The repayment amount is only consumed by the repayment calculation.
The order price is normalised into the order placement operation.
The sell token amount is normalised into the sell order placement operation.
The buy order id is only used by the match operation.
The sell order id is only used by the match operation.
The fill rate is a transient local of the order filling routine.
The published rate is a transient local of the order filling routine.
The traded wei amount is a transient local of the order filling routine.
The traded token amount is a transient local of the order filling routine.
The product id is normalised into the loan product creation operation.
The term parameter is only stored in the loan product.
The discount rate parameter is only stored in the loan product.
The collateral ratio parameter is only stored in the loan product.
The minimum disbursed amount parameter is only stored in the loan product.
The defaulting fee parameter is only stored in the loan product.
The active flag parameter is only stored in the product records.
The token value is a transient local of the loan creation routine.
The maturity value is a transient local of the loan creation routine.
The lock product id is normalised into the lock product creation operation.
The per term interest is normalised into the interest computation operation.
The duration parameter is only stored in the lock product.
The minimum lock amount parameter is only stored in the lock product.
The lock owner is normalised into the lock creation operation.
The interest earned is a transient local of the lock creation routine.
The lockedUntil value is a transient local of the lock creation routine.
The narrative string is normalised into the system account withdrawal event.
The raw signature bytes are only consumed by the signature recovery routine.
The message hash is only consumed by the signature recovery routine.
